crew.overview: When the renegade crew of Serenity agrees to hide a fugitive on their ship, they find themselves in an action-packed battle between the relentless military might of a totalitarian regime who will destroy anything – or anyone – to get the girl back and the bloodthirsty creatures who roam the uncharted areas of space. But... the greatest danger of all may be on their ship.
crew.title: Serenity

details.biography: Marcus Stokes is an American television director and writer based in Los Angeles, California. He holds a Master’s degree in Architectural Design from the University of California. He first worked a computer graphics artist at George Lucas’ Industrial Light and Magic and began his directorial career working as a commercial director.
details.name: Marcus Stokes
